title: Activation waves playbook for SDK surface: function calling, structured output & streaming samples
creator: Jordan Meyers
description: Playbook to coordinate rollout of new SDK surface changes (function calling schema improvements, canonical structured output types, streaming SDK improvements). Goal: staged activation across self-serve hosted API users and upstream SDK consumers with clear release notes, sample artifacts, localized snippets, and telemetry for regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Release notes drafted and validated by Docs and Legal
Sample kits (JS, Python, Go) published with runnable examples for function calling, structured JSON schema, and streaming incremental response handling
Cross-team readiness call completed with Engineering, Docs, SDK, Sales, and Support
Canary rollout gating metrics defined and dashboards created (latency, error rate, sample regression score)
Deprecation/compatibility guidance published for older SDKs and model variants
rollout_plan: Phase 0 - Dry run (internal): distribute sample kit to 10 internal teams, collect feedback - target 2025-03-05
Phase 1 - Canary (limited public): enable new SDK surface for 2% of new signups and selected partners - target 2025-03-12
Phase 2 - Gradual ramp: 25% traffic after 72h if canary metrics stable - target 2025-03-15
Phase 3 - General availability: full rollout with migration guidance and deprecation timeline - target 2025-03-21
Rollback policy: automatic rollback to previous SDK behavior on sustained error spike > 2x baseline for 30m or user-visible structured output regression alerts
release_notes_tasks: Draft top-level summary and impact section (PM) - include migration highlights for function calling and streaming
Change log entries for SDKs with code snippets and compatibility notes (SDK owners)
Security/Privacy blurb reviewed and approved by Security (KMS/HSM notes if relevant)
Telemetry and metric changes documented (new telemetry events: sdk.v2.stream_start, sdk.v2.funccall.invoke)
FAQ and known issues section maintained during canary
docs_and_samples: Sample kit repo link: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-samples/activation-waves (PR template: add smoke test)
Include runnable notebooks for Python and TypeScript demonstrating: synchronous function calls, JSON schema validation for structured output, streaming partial-update aggregation
Localization: extract strings for zh-CN and de, coordinate translation by 2025-03-10
Create short video walkthroughs (2-3 mins) for key migration flows for partner enablement
